title: Block Usage Percentage on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Repeat Orders
content:
Repeat-order usage schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: a repeat order earns a percentage granted to the repeat-order price according to how much of the current block has been used.

**Used share.** The share of the current block's hours already used is its hours drawn less its hours reversed, divided by its hours purchased, all read from the current block's hours ledger and record.

**Schedule.**

| Used share of the current block | Percentage earned |
|---|---|
| at least 0.90 (90 percent) | 4 |
| at least 0.70 (70 percent) and below 0.90 | 2 |
| below 0.70 | none |

Hypothetical cases on a 40-hour block: 36.00 hours drawn and none reversed is a share of 0.90 and earns 4 percent; 37.00 drawn with 2.00 reversed is 35.00 net, a share of 0.875, and earns 2 percent; 28.00 drawn is exactly 0.70 and earns 2 percent; 27.96 drawn is 0.699 and earns none.
